description_te: AP లోని మహిళలు, బాలికలు మరియు తృతీయ లింగ వ్యక్తులకు APSRTC బస్సుల్లో ఉచిత ప్రయాణం. ~2.62 కోట్ల మహిళలు benefited.
description_en: Free bus travel on eligible APSRTC services for all women, girls, and transgender persons domiciled in AP. ~2.62 crore women expected to benefit.

eligibility_criteria.gender: All women, girls, and transgender persons
eligibility_criteria.eligible_services: Pallevelugu, Ultra Pallevelugu, Express Services, Metro Express, City Ordinary
eligibility_criteria.excluded_services: Non-Stop, Chartered, Super Luxury, Ultra Deluxe, Star Liner, AC buses, Saptagiri Express, Interstate services, Package tours

mandatory: Any valid government photo ID: Aadhaar card / Voter ID / Passport / Driving Licence

benefit_amount: Free bus travel on eligible APSRTC services (zero fare)
application_process_te:
1. ప్రత్యేక application అవసరం లేదు
2. Eligible bus ఎక్కండి
3. Valid govt photo ID చూపించండి
4. Conductor verify చేసి zero-fare ticket issue చేస్తారు
go_reference: Super Six scheme launched 15 August 2025 by TDP government
